_comment: Hand-added talents the tlidb import can't name. 80001600: the core talent an Ethereal Prism grants (seen on CoffeeTerra's Psychic tree; text from tlidb's Escalating Affliction hyperlink, current season).

80001600.name: Escalating Affliction
80001600.text:
Changes the effect of each point of Affliction to: +0.1% - +3% additional Damage Over Time taken. Refreshes every 1s and is affected by Lucky Damage bonuses
90% of the bonuses and additional bonuses for Max Damage is also applied to Damage Over Time
